item.title: DeadLock Ransomware Uses Polygon Smart Contracts to Make Extortion Infra Harder to Disrupt
item.summary: The ransomware group known as DeadLock has been observed using decentralized infrastructure to facilitate victim communications and data leak operations in a bid to improve operational resilience.
